originality.rationale: The assessed contribution is the exact characteristic-seven Newton stratification of the normalized (3,5) trigonal pencil, including the scheme-theoretic double Hasse divisor, unique smooth nonordinary parameter, nilpotent Cartier type and arithmetic Newton polygon. Full-text primary comparisons found a general curve model, generic tame-cover rank results, general Kummer coefficient machinery, an exclusion of superspecial genus-four curves and finite-field statistics, but no statement implying the complete parameter classification. The special Fermat zeta polynomial may follow from classical Jacobi sums and is not asserted to be separately novel. Two differently normalized cyclic covers or a finite-field database do not imply this all-geometric-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: This is an explicit complete Newton-polygon stratification of a natural one-parameter cyclic trigonal genus-four family in characteristic seven, with a unique smooth rank-zero non-supersingular fiber, a double Hasse divisor, and exact all-extension parameter counts. The Fermat-type exceptional geometry and strong ordinary-to-fractional-slope jump give intrinsic motivation beyond an arbitrary finite computation. The result is not claimed as a large classification of trigonal curves or as separately novel Fermat-point zeta arithmetic.
